title: Amazing effects!
text: We had an amazing time at this museum the illusions are amazing and create fantastic photo’s. I can’t believe that they are just paintings that can create such an amazing effect. The museum has photo ideas on the walls so you are able to recreate them if you want to as sometimes it’s hard to know what to do to create a good effect. They also have spots to stand on so that you are in the correct position to take the optimal photo. It wasn’t very busy when we visited so we could take our time taking the best shots. Thoroughly recommend this place.Give this place a go you won’t regret it.
author: clairegZ8123IU

title: Recommended
text:
The Museum of Illusions in Barcelona is a unique and fun experience, perfect for all ages. Located in the heart of the city, it offers an interactive journey through a series of optical illusions and 3D murals that seem to come to life before your eyes. The museum includes about 60 murals, and for each one is marked exactly where to position themselves to take the photo and make it as realistic as possible. The scenes range from fantastical settings to comic situations, such as riding a dragon, crossing a suspension bridge or escaping a dinosaur.

title: 1st time in spain
text: Upon walking in, you don’t really know what to expect. The instructions don’t really tell you that there are pictures up about what you’re supposed to do. But, we figured it out along the way.
